prompt: Independently inspect each numbered egocentric image and find its named hand/manipulator. Use the whole visible foreground support: hand plus attached visible forearm, including any worn glove. Exclude background and unrelated body regions. Do NOT cut the forearm off at an anatomical wrist. Estimate the AREA CENTROID of this visible foreground mask (not a joint or bounding-box center), and its tight bounding box [left,top,right,bottom]. Coordinates normalized [0,1] in each image. If absent/occluded/ambiguous abstain. No tracker output or source masks are supplied. Return JSON only: {"labels": [{"index":0,"visible":true,"x":0.5,"y":0.5,"bbox":[0.2,0.2,0.8,0.8],"confidence":0.9}, ...]}. One label for each index. No explanation.
